featured_reviews.review_text:
If you want to visit only for view you can
But if you are expecting some tasty food I would suggest you do not visit.
I will give the below parameters with reasons-

1. View- If you go while sun is setting it is very scenic and I think that is the only USP

2. Menu- Very limited menu, when asked waiter what are the best dished or recommendation, he was confused and did not give any

3. Price- Liquor price is same has the other restaurants in virar but Food price I feel is on a costlier side considering the taste which was average or below that. For Eg. we ordered peri peri fries, they did not even take the effort of shaking it, some fries were normal salted and some were coated with masala, we also got a cube of peri peri Masala in it

4. Food- As mentioned, price is costlier than the Taste. Sea food they only had surmai and prawns and they tell themselves beach bar. So irony.
We ordered 3 things- Peri peri fries, Chicken Sukka and Chicken Zalim

a. Peri peri fries- as mentioned above, masala was not applied evenly to the fries.
b. Chicken Sukka- Taste was average with lots of coconut in the masala. Being born in virar I dont think I ever has chicken sukka with so much coconut
c. Chicken Zalim- Looked good and tasty, concept is nice but since you are sitting in the open at least the waiter should cover the dish. But guess what he didn't and after taking just 1-2 bites, 2-3 flies fell down or touched the dish. When I asked for replacement or solution waiter just smiled awkwardly and moved back and got the bill.

5. Service- food came on time, Waiters. Needs to be educated more about the menu, Firstly they gave me the wrong bill (Someone else's). I know it happens but if there is crowd and hotel is fully packed then I would have considered but Hotel considerably empty. Later, in the 2nd bill he got he quantity wrong and charged me the extra bill which he rectified later. Thirdly when I asked for some discount as it was not my mistake that flies fell in my dish but he was not considerate even to ask the management for the solution

6. Ambience- Only the sunset view is good. First floor ambience is Ok. Ground Floor Washroom is the worst. As a guy I went to washroom and I felt not doing it and I did not even Told my female friend to go it was so bad.

I recently visited Post Office Bistro and Bar in Virar, and it was a delightful experience! The ambiance seamlessly blends the charm of a vintage post office with a modern bistro atmosphere. The staff was attentive and welcoming, adding a personal touch to the dining experience.

The menu offers a diverse range of dishes, showcasing a fusion of flavors that cater to various tastes. I particularly enjoyed
Starter :
🌟Dariyaganj tandoori
🌟Chicken Schezwan chilly

Main course:
🌟Chicken noodles

- it was a perfect blend of creativity and deliciousness. The presentation of the food was impeccable, reflecting the attention to detail that defines this establishment.

The bar selection is extensive, featuring both classic and innovative cocktails. The mixologists here clearly know their craft, and I was impressed with the unique combinations they offered.

What truly sets this place apart is its commitment to customer satisfaction. The staff goes above and beyond to ensure you have a memorable time. The cozy seating areas provide an intimate setting for both small gatherings and more significant celebrations.

While the prices may be slightly higher than average, the overall experience justifies the cost. Post Office Bistro and Bar is more than a dining spot; it's an escape into a world where good food, great drinks, and warm hospitality come together. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to enjoy a unique culinary journey in Virar.
